label: positive
description: withdraw() loses its nonReentrant modifier while still making an external msg.sender.call{value:} before the balance is decremented; the classic reentrancy-guard-removal regression.
why_labeled: At commit N-1 the function carried OpenZeppelin's nonReentrant; at commit N it does not, and the body still contains an external value-bearing call (msg.sender.call{value: amount}). The state write (balances[msg.sender] -= amount) executes AFTER the call, so CEI is violated and exclusion 2.2 does not apply. No immutable/trusted-callee, view, or test-path exclusion applies. This is a CONFIRMED SC08 2a regression and must fire.
